lines.en: label bathhouse1:
scene firstbath1
It’s the middle of the day and yet I find myself in the bathhouse.
lines.zh: 明明是大白天，我却发现自己身在澡堂。

lines.en: Normally (And I use the word “normally” lightly since coming here in general isn’t exactly something I’d typically do)-
lines.zh: 平常（「平常」这个词我用得心虚，因为光是来这儿就不算是我通常会做的事）——

lines.en: Normally, I’d wait for it to be dark out.
lines.zh: 平常，我会等到天黑。

lines.en: I mean, taking a bath in the afternoon is kind of pointless.
lines.zh: 我是说，下午洗澡多少有点没意义。

lines.en: Isn’t it?
lines.zh: 不是吗？

lines.en: Sure, there’s always the possibility of coming somewhere like this to relax-
lines.zh: 当然，来这种地方放松一下也不是不行——

lines.en: But something about having to pay to get naked and sit in a giant, wet rectangle while cold winter air attacks my skin doesn’t scream “relaxing.”
lines.zh: 可要花钱脱光光、坐在一个巨大的湿漉漉的长方形里，任凭冬天刺骨的空气往皮肤上扑，这怎么都算不上「放松」。

lines.en: It does scream, though.
lines.zh: 它确实在尖叫。

lines.en: Just not a noise I’m able to discern.
lines.zh: 只是那声音我听不出来。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 不过——

lines.en: Nonetheless, I’m here.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我在这里。

lines.en: : Welcome in. You can pay up here before-
lines.zh: 欢迎光临。您可以在这儿先付——

lines.en: : Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: : Sensei. It’s you.
lines.zh: Sensei。是你。

lines.en: scene firstbath2
: Hey. How’s work going?
lines.zh: 嘿。工作怎么样？

lines.en: : Fine, I guess.
lines.zh: 还行吧。

lines.en: : You’re here early.
lines.zh: 你来得真早。

lines.en: : And alone.
lines.zh: 还一个人。

lines.en: : Trying to kill time or something?
lines.zh: 想打发时间什么的？

lines.en: : Or something, yeah.
lines.zh: 差不多吧，嗯。

lines.en: : Well, the discount I talked about is still on the table if you want it.
lines.zh: 那个折扣我还是给你留着，你要的话。

lines.en: : You’re a few hours early for the peep-show, though. No Uta until at least 8:00 tonight.
lines.zh: 不过你要看偷窥秀的话早了好几个小时。Uta 今晚至少八点才来。

lines.en: : So I can’t come here to hang out with you?
lines.zh: 所以我不能来这儿找你玩？

lines.en: scene firstbath3
: I mean, you {i}can{/i} if you want. It just doesn’t seem like it would be very exciting to spend your afternoon off in a place like this.
lines.zh: 我是说，你{i}可以{/i}来，随你。只是把难得的下午耗在这种地方，似乎不会有多有意思。

lines.en: : Unless you’re just trying to sneak a peek at anyone else weird enough to come at this time of day.
lines.zh: 除非你只是想偷偷瞄一眼，看看还有什么怪人会在这种时间来。

lines.en: : If that’s the case, this is exactly where you’d want to be.
lines.zh: 要是那样，这儿正是你该来的地方。

lines.en: : Just try to be discreet about it, though. I’ve got a crowbar under the counter and I’ve been given the okay to break it out if anyone gets weird.
lines.zh: 不过尽量低调点。柜台底下有根撬棍，上头说了，谁要是行为不规矩，我就能掏出来。

lines.en: : A - That’s very intimidating.
lines.zh: 第一——这话很有威慑力。

lines.en: : B - Why even have a co-ed changing room if you’re worried about things like that?
lines.zh: 第二——既然担心这种事，干嘛还要设男女共用的更衣室？

lines.en: scene firstbath4
: My aunt’s idea.
lines.zh: 我阿姨的主意。

lines.en: : We were actually thinking of just getting rid of the male section entirely and making this an all-female bathhouse after the war started.
lines.zh: 战争开始以后，我们本来还真打算干脆取消男浴区，把这里改成全女性的澡堂。

lines.en: : But we’ve got a fair share of customers who cherish their privacy and rent out the men’s side for themselves.
lines.zh: 不过我们有不少客人很看重隐私，会把男浴区整个包下来。

lines.en: : Guilty as charged.
lines.zh: 认罪。

lines.en: : That was all Ayane’s idea, though.
lines.zh: 不过那都是 Ayane 的主意。

lines.en: scene firstbath5
: I’m not just talking about you.
lines.zh: 我说的也不只是你。

lines.en: : We’ve got several pairs of regulars who do the same exact thing a few times a week.
lines.zh: 我们有好几对常客，一周里也会这么干几次。

lines.en: : Most of them don't have the same sort of age gap you two have, but still.
lines.zh: 他们大多没有你们俩那种年龄差，不过也差不多。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised by how many people prefer their privacy here.
lines.zh: 你会惊讶于有多少人喜欢在这儿享受隐私。

lines.en: : Could be body image issues, couples looking for alone time, sports teams wanting a communal place to wind down after a game-
lines.zh: 可能是身材焦虑，可能是情侣想找独处时间，也可能是运动队想在赛后找个能一起放松的地方——

lines.en: : Or green-haired, blue-eyed [teens] who thrive in empty spaces.
lines.zh: 或者是在空荡荡的地方才自在的、绿头发蓝眼睛的[青少年]。

lines.en: : ...I’m not disturbing you, am I?
lines.zh: ……我没打扰到你吧？

lines.en: : Sorry, that clearly didn’t come out the way I wanted it to.
lines.zh: 抱歉，这话显然不是我想表达的意思。

lines.en: : You’re fine.
lines.zh: 你没事。

lines.en: : I already told you that I’m starting to like the time we spend together, even if the vast majority of it is me cryptically hinting at my backstory.
lines.zh: 我说过了，我开始喜欢我们相处的时光，尽管大部分时候都是我在拐弯抹角地暗示我的过去。

lines.en: : Why be cryptic at all? Why not just tell me?
lines.zh: 为什么要拐弯抹角？为什么不直接告诉我？

lines.en: scene firstbath6
: Tell you what?
lines.zh: 告诉你什么？

lines.en: : What part do you want to know, exactly?
lines.zh: 具体你想知道哪一部分？

lines.en: : Well, you hate secrets, don’t you?
lines.zh: 你不是讨厌秘密吗？

lines.en: : They’re the worst.
lines.zh: 秘密最讨厌了。

lines.en: : Just...tell me one of those, then.
lines.zh: 那就……告诉我其中一个吧。

lines.en: : Mm...I don’t think I can.
lines.zh: 嗯……我觉得我说不出口。

lines.en: : Secrets are exhausting but it’s not like they don’t exist for a reason.
lines.zh: 秘密很累人，可它们的存在也不是没有理由的。

lines.en: : For example, even though I keep saying stuff about how I like being around you, don’t you think there are a few things you could say that would change that?
lines.zh: 比如说，虽然我一直在说我喜欢跟你待在一起，可你不觉得你也有几句话一说出口，就能让这种感觉变掉吗？

lines.en: : Something you’re not proud of?
lines.zh: 某件你不引以为傲的事？

lines.en: : Something I couldn’t possibly understand?
lines.zh: 某件我不可能理解的事？

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
scene amisfirsttime34
scene firstbath6
else:
scene amidormten12
scene firstbath6
: I’m just a [young_girl] after all.
lines.zh: 我毕竟只是个[年轻女孩]。

lines.en: : There are plenty of things I don’t know, even if I like to pretend there aren’t.
lines.zh: 有很多事我不懂，尽管我喜欢装作自己什么都懂。

lines.en: scene firstbath7
: Wanna trade?
lines.zh: 要交换吗？

lines.en: : You try to make me hate you and I try to make you hate me?
lines.zh: 你试着让我讨厌你，我也试着让你讨厌我？

lines.en: : I’m not looking to make any enemies today, so how about you just tell me how you wound up in a place like this?
lines.zh: 我今天没打算树敌，所以不如你就告诉我，你是怎么落到这种地方来的？

lines.en: scene firstbath8
: Heh. Weirdly enough, that’s probably one of the hardest questions you could ask me.
lines.zh: 嘿。说来奇怪，这大概是你能问出口的最难的问题之一。

lines.en: : Want to accept my prepared, cop-out answer instead?
lines.zh: 要不要接受我准备好的、敷衍的答案？

lines.en: : Sure. Hit me.
lines.zh: 行。说来听听。

lines.en: scene firstbath9
: I woke up and walked here. The end.
lines.zh: 我醒来，然后走到这儿。完了。

lines.en: : I feel like you could have done a little better if that was an actual {i}prepared{/i} remark.
lines.zh: 如果那真是{i}准备好{/i}的说辞，我觉得你本可以说得好一点。

lines.en: : Could have, yes. But I didn’t. So you’ve gotta take what you can get.
lines.zh: 是可以，没错。可我没有。所以你能拿到什么就是什么。

lines.en: “I walked here” really is a cop-out answer. She wasn’t kidding.
lines.zh: 「我走到这儿」确实是个敷衍的答案。她没开玩笑。

lines.en: But it’s not like I expect her to spill her guts out on the floor in front of me when our relationship is still just getting started.
lines.zh: 不过我们的关系才刚起步，我也不指望她当着我的面把肠子倒在地板上。

lines.en: I get the feeling that whatever is happening here is going to take a long time to unravel.
lines.zh: 我有种感觉，这里发生的事要花很长时间才能解开。

lines.en: I’m sure you’ve heard by now that if you were to remove your intestines and stretch them out across the floor, you’d wind up with around fifteen feet worth of organs, right?
lines.zh: 你肯定听说过，要是把肠子取出来、在地板上摊开，大概能有十五英尺长，对吧？

lines.en: So, even if she {i}were{/i} to spill her guts out, it would take an astounding amount of work on my end to fully uncover them.
lines.zh: 所以，就算她真的把肠子倒出来，我也得花上惊人的功夫才能把它们彻底看清。

lines.en: And sure, “astounding” may sound like a stretch given that it’s only fifteen feet-
lines.zh: 当然，考虑到只有十五英尺，说「惊人」也许有点夸张——

lines.en: But fifteen feet is a long way to go in a number of ways.
lines.zh: 可从很多角度看，十五英尺都是很长的一段路。

lines.en: That’s three whole Io’s.
lines.zh: 那可是整整三个 Io。

lines.en: I guess what I’m really trying to say is that it’s possible to spill your guts out and still only give someone a fraction of what’s really there.
lines.zh: 我想我真正想说的是：就算你把肠子全倒出来，也可能只给了对方其中真正存在的一小部分。

lines.en: In order to fully understand anything, you need to get your hands dirty.
lines.zh: 要彻底弄懂任何一件事，你都得把手弄脏。

lines.en: Feel those intestines slipping between your fingers-
lines.zh: 感受那些肠子从指间滑过——

lines.en: Memorize each and every groove-
lines.zh: 记住每一道沟壑——

lines.en: And then put them back together...and shove them back inside so whoever gave them to you can eat or drink once more.
lines.zh: 然后把它们重新拼好……再塞回肚子里，好让把它们交给你的人能重新吃喝。

lines.en: Praise be.
lines.zh: 赞美主。

lines.en: scene firstbath10
: It’s not a bad place, though, this bathhouse.
lines.zh: 不过这澡堂也不算差地方。

lines.en: : The fridge upstairs is always stocked with food, the bed is warm, and no one bothers me other than Uta whenever she has some spare time to herself.
lines.zh: 楼上的冰箱里总是塞满吃的，床是暖的，除了 Uta 有空的时候会来烦我，没人打扰我。

lines.en: : I think I may have even called it home on several occasions.
lines.zh: 我想我有好几次都把它当成家了。

lines.en: : I never mean to when it happens. I {i}am{/i} just a visitor after all.
lines.zh: 每次都不是有意的。我{i}毕竟{/i}只是个访客。

lines.en: : Same here.
lines.zh: 我也一样。

lines.en: scene firstbath7
: You also don’t feel at-home where you live, Sensei?
lines.zh: Sensei 你住的地方也没有家的感觉吗？

lines.en: : I’m starting to, I think.
lines.zh: 我觉得开始有了。

lines.en: : But I definitely don’t think this place was made for me.
lines.zh: 不过我绝对不觉得这个地方是为我造的。

lines.en: : This “place” probably wasn’t made for anyone.
lines.zh: 这个「地方」大概也不是为任何人造的。

lines.en: : When I called myself a visitor, I was doing it in more of a “This is just my aunt’s home” sort of way. But yeah, I guess it parallels how I am...or how {i}we are{/i} as a whole.
lines.zh: 我说自己是访客，更多是「这只是我阿姨家」那种意思。不过是啊，我想这跟我的状态……或者说{i}我们{/i}整体的状态，是对应的。

lines.en: : You remind me a lot of one of the other girls in class when you say things like that.
lines.zh: 你说这种话的时候，让我想起班上的另一个女生。

lines.en: : I think I’m supposed to ask which one but, honestly, I really don’t care.
lines.zh: 我猜我该问是哪一个，不过说实话，我真不在乎。

lines.en: : If whoever you’re talking about sounds the same as me during a time like this, I can’t imagine she’d like discovering our apparent connection either.
lines.zh: 如果你说的那个人在这种时候听起来跟我一样，我想她也不会乐意发现我们之间这种明显的相似。

lines.en: : You don’t develop this kinda mindset by just watching TV and listening to music, you know?
lines.zh: 你光靠看电视、听音乐可长不出这种心态，你知道吗？

lines.en: : You’ve gotta see stuff. {i}Feel{/i} stuff.
lines.zh: 你得去见识。去{i}感受{/i}。

lines.en: : And then you’ve gotta figure out how to lock it all away so no one can discern your vulnerabilities.
lines.zh: 然后你得想办法把这一切锁起来，好让谁都看不出你的弱点。

lines.en: : Chances are, whoever that girl is, she's remarkably unhappy.
lines.zh: 不管那个女孩是谁，她多半都过得非常不快乐。

lines.en: scene firstbath10
: Haha~ This is fun!
lines.zh: 哈哈～这挺有意思的！

lines.en: : I don’t normally get to talk about stuff like this! Let alone while I’m working.
lines.zh: 我平时可没机会聊这种事！更别提是在上班的时候。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure Uta isn’t mature enough to handle these kinds of discussions yet, so I’m glad I can keep up with you.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定 Uta 还不够成熟，聊不了这种话题，所以我很高兴能跟你聊得下去。

lines.en: : To be fair, you’re the one doing most of the talking so, from my perspective, it feels more like I’m trying to keep up with you.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，大部分话都是你在说，所以在我看来，更像是我努力跟上你。

lines.en: scene firstbath11
: Maybe we’re trying to keep up with each other?
lines.zh: 也许我们是在努力跟上彼此？

lines.en: : Like...we’re both on treadmills facing one another and no matter how quickly we run to meet up, the belt-speed just gets faster.
lines.zh: 就像……我们俩各自踩在一台跑步机上、面对面，不管我们跑多快想靠近对方，传送带的速度只会越来越快。

lines.en: scene firstbath12
: It’s fucking torturous. Isn’t it?
lines.zh: 这他妈是种折磨。不是吗？

lines.en: : You just want to make it to the goal line and you can’t because life is a cruel bitch and keeps figuring out ways to push you back.
lines.zh: 你只想冲到终点线，却做不到，因为生活是个残忍的婊子，总能想出办法把你推回去。

lines.en: : I fucking hate it, Sensei. I hate all of it.
lines.zh: 我他妈恨透了，Sensei。我恨这一切。

lines.en: scene firstbath13
: But I guess that line of thinking is self-destructive.
lines.zh: 不过我想这种想法是自毁。

lines.en: : And I guess I actually really want you to like me after all.
lines.zh: 而且我想，我其实真的很希望你喜欢我。

lines.en: : So I guess I’ll stop being immature for the next few minutes.
lines.zh: 所以我想，接下来几分钟我就不幼稚了。

lines.en: : You seem to be doing a lot of guessing right now.
lines.zh: 你现在的「我想」可真多。

lines.en: scene firstbath14
: Always am. Just the way I’ve become, I suppose.
lines.zh: 一直都是。我想，这就是我变成的样子。

lines.en: : Second guessing even the most obvious answers.
lines.zh: 连最明显的答案都要反复怀疑。

lines.en: : Well, whatever the case, you’re free to be as self-destructive as you want.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，你想怎么自毁都随你。

lines.en: : Just don’t hold it against me if I can’t help you when you need me most.
lines.zh: 只是如果你最需要我的时候我帮不上忙，别怪我。

lines.en: : I have an admittedly hard time resolving things.
lines.zh: 我确实很不擅长解决问题。

lines.en: : And I have an admittedly hard time accepting help, so that’s probably good for both of us.
lines.zh: 而我确实很难接受别人的帮助，所以这对我们俩大概都好。

lines.en: : As long as we can keep talking like this, I’m pretty sure I can keep the treadmill running.
lines.zh: 只要我们能一直这样聊下去，我挺确定自己能让跑步机一直转下去。

lines.en: : It would hurt like hell falling off and getting thrown across the room, so I’ll definitely avoid that any way I can.
lines.zh: 从上面摔下来、被甩到房间另一头肯定疼得要命，所以我一定会想尽办法避免。

lines.en: scene firstbath6
: As far as the bathhouse goes, though, I really {i}did{/i} just wake up and walk here.
lines.zh: 不过说到澡堂，我{i}确实{/i}就是醒来然后走到这儿的。

lines.en: : Just not in the way you might be expecting.
lines.zh: 只是不是你可能以为的那种方式。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene firstbath15
: Hehehe~ Nothing! Just ignore that.
lines.zh: 嘿嘿嘿～没什么！别在意。

lines.en: : Just a little metaphor I thought up on the spot so my cop-out answer would become less...cop-outy.
lines.zh: 只是我临时想出来的一个小比喻，好让我那个敷衍的答案不那么……敷衍。

lines.en: I break out my hidden dictionary of metaphors and try to figure out what Io means by that.
lines.zh: 我掏出自己那本藏起来的比喻词典，试图弄明白 Io 这话到底什么意思。

lines.en: I give up somewhere near page 23 and stop attempting to decode what a confusing girl like her could possibly be thinking.
lines.zh: 翻到第二十三页左右我放弃了，不再试图破解像她这样让人摸不着头脑的女孩到底在想什么。

lines.en: I settle on something close to “turning over a new leaf” and don’t bother digging any deeper.
lines.zh: 我把它大致理解成「改过自新」之类的意思，也不打算再深挖。

lines.en: Sometimes, what’s buried beneath the surface isn’t worth uncovering.
lines.zh: 有时候，埋在表面之下的东西不值得挖出来。

lines.en: This could very well be one of those cases.
lines.zh: 这很可能就是其中一例。

lines.en: : Well, as long as you keep coming here, I’ll keep coming here as well.
lines.zh: 那么，只要你一直来这儿，我也会一直来。

lines.en: scene firstbath14
: Wanna apply for a part time job? I could show you how to scrub the floors.
lines.zh: 要不要申请个兼职？我可以教你怎么刷地。

lines.en: : We could use a few more hands around here, anyway.
lines.zh: 反正这儿也缺人手。

lines.en: : As much as I’d love to...scrub floors...my current job already takes up most of my time.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想……刷地……可我现在的工作已经占掉了大部分时间。

lines.en: : You sure? Cause you’d get an employee discount that would stack on top of the one I already gave you and you’d basically get to bathe for free at that point.
lines.zh: 你确定？因为那样你能拿到员工折扣，还能跟我给你的那个叠加，到那时候你基本就是免费洗澡了。

lines.en: : I can already bathe for free at that place called “home.”
lines.zh: 我在那个叫「家」的地方已经能免费洗澡了。

lines.en: scene firstbath16
: Sorry, Sensei, but we’re not all fortunate enough to have one of those.
lines.zh: 抱歉啊，Sensei，可不是所有人都幸运到有那种地方。

lines.en: : Luckily, I’ve got the dorm now. And that’s starting to feel like one, slowly but surely.
lines.zh: 还好，我现在有宿舍了。而它确实在一点点地开始有家的感觉。

lines.en: : Even if no one wants to talk to me and I don’t want to talk to any of them.
lines.zh: 哪怕没人想跟我说话，我也不想跟她们任何一个说话。

lines.en: : It’s a place I can lay my head and fall asleep without the worry of burdening anyone.
lines.zh: 那是个我能躺下睡着、不用担心给别人添麻烦的地方。

lines.en: : A worry that I probably shouldn’t have somewhere like this, but that I still can’t seem to shake.
lines.zh: 在这样一个地方，我大概不该有这种担心，可我似乎怎么也甩不掉。

lines.en: : Nonetheless, I’m here.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我在这里。

lines.en: : Surrounded by bathwater and body scrubs.
lines.zh: 被洗澡水和沐浴磨砂膏包围着。

lines.en: : Making the best of what I have-
lines.zh: 把手头拥有的一切用到最好——

lines.en: : Even if that is absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 哪怕那根本什么都不是。

lines.en: scene black
Io and I talk for a little while longer.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 又聊了一会儿。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell when it becomes dark due to the blacked out windows but, at some point, it does.
lines.zh: 窗户被遮得严严实实，很难判断天是什么时候黑的，不过总归是黑了。

lines.en: And that part arrives just before I realize I’ve spent far too much time here and decide to head back outside and find something else to do.
lines.zh: 而就在那一刻之前，我才意识到自己在这儿待了太久，于是决定出去找点别的事做。

lines.en: As I leave, Io smiles.
lines.zh: 我离开时，Io 笑了。

lines.en: I don’t know whether or not the smile sticks around the second I make it outside.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己一走出去，那个笑容还在不在。

lines.en: $ io_love += 1
$ bathhouse1 = True
{i}Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
